text:
You need a visually appealing WordPress landing page that follows your mockup, supports lead generation, works well on mobile, and includes email marketing integration, tracking pixels, and A/B testing.

I’m Tobias Reyne, and I bring 7 years of full-stack experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. While my core background is in modern web development, I’m very comfortable working closely from a design mockup, translating it into clean, responsive front-end implementation, and making sure the technical pieces behind a landing page are set up carefully and reliably.

One project that’s relevant is a home goods storefront rebuild for Juniper & Ash Home. I replaced a slow theme-based shop with a headless storefront and CMS the marketing team could edit themselves. The result was a largest contentful paint improvement from 4.1s to 1.3s, and organic traffic increased by 38% in 3 months. That project required attention to performance, SEO-aware structure, and a polished user experience, which aligns well with what you need for a high-converting landing page.

For your page, I would focus on:
- accurate implementation of the provided mockup
- mobile responsiveness across screen sizes
- clean HTML/CSS/JavaScript structure
- integration with your email marketing platform
- tracking pixel setup
- A/B testing implementation
- SEO best practices where appropriate for a landing page

I’m detail-oriented and used to delivering work that needs to be both visually polished and technically sound. If your design is already finalized, I can move efficiently from mockup to implementation and keep the build focused on conversion, clarity, and speed.

If you’d like, I can also help think through any small implementation details that improve lead generation without deviating from your design.
